replies.What is your relationship with mathemati: Mathematics feels like a distant language to me. I have a master's degree, and my parents both studied STEM, so it's in my background. I never enjoyed it; I still find it dry and rigid. I prefer biology and coding where things feel more organic.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Honestly, yes. I get a tight chest when forced to solve problems. I worry about making mistakes and looking foolish. It feels overwhelming, especially now that I'm thirty-five and supposed to be expert. The pressure is real.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I tried a few apps last year. Honestly, it made me more frustrated. The explanations were too mechanical for someone who already hates the subject. I ended up going back to old textbooks instead because they felt more human.

replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: PCA simplifies data by finding new axes that capture most variance. You calculate the covariance matrix and find its eigenvectors. Yes, it can be scary, but you don't need to be an expert. It's just about finding patterns in the data without stress.
replies.According to you, how can LLMs be used t: LLMs can tutor students in a way that feels more human. They can explain concepts in different ways until the student understands. It removes the fear of judgment and makes math less intimidating for everyone involved.
